details.description: Mixtral 8x7B is Mistral AI's sparse mixture-of-experts base model, released December 11, 2023 under an Apache 2.0 license. It has 46.7 billion total parameters but activates only 12.9 billion per token, using a router that selects 2 of 8 expert groups per token, and Mistral's launch post reports fluency in English, French, Italian, German and Spanish with a 32K-token context window. This is the pretrained (non-instruct) checkpoint, released alongside an instruction-tuned sibling; its Hugging Face model card states it 'does not have any moderation mechanisms.' Mistral deprecated the Mixtral 8x7B family on its own hosted platform (La Plateforme) on November 30, 2024 and retired it March 30, 2025, recommending Mistral Small 4 as a replacement; the open weights remain available through third-party hosts.
advantages: Mistral's launch post reports it outperforms Llama 2 70B on most benchmarks tested, with 6x faster inference.
Scores 41.03 on MMLU-Pro, per its Hugging Face model card evaluation results.
Activates only 12.9 billion parameters out of 46.7 billion total per token, per Mistral's launch announcement.
Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license, allowing unrestricted self-hosting and fine-tuning.
disadvantages: Is a pretrained base checkpoint, not instruction-tuned; its Hugging Face model card states it 'does not have any moderation mechanisms.'
Deprecated on Mistral's own hosted API as of November 30, 2024 and retired March 30, 2025, with Mistral recommending Mistral Small 4 as a replacement.
Fireworks AI's hosting of this model does not support fine-tuning, function calling, embeddings, reranking or image input.
use_cases: Base checkpoint for fine-tuning custom instruction-following or domain-specific models
Multilingual text generation and completion research
